## The situation you were in

What you were trying to decide or fix when you came here and found nothing.

## Where you looked

Which files you checked first. This helps if the answer exists but is in the wrong place.

## Why it is not already covered

If a nearby file almost covers it, say which one and what it stops short of.

## What you did instead (optional)

How you solved it, and whether it worked. A gap reported with a tested answer is far more useful than one without.
